games.headline: Brown, Maxey and James combine for 78 points in 76ers' 127-121 win over Bulls
games.desc: — Jaylen Brown scored 29 points, Tyrese Maxey added 27 and LeBron James had his highest-scoring effort so far in a Philadelphia uniform as the 76ers held off the struggling Chicago Bulls 127-121 on Sunday afternoon.

games.headline: Austin Reaves steps in for Luka Donic with 43 points in Lakers win over Pistons
games.desc: — Austin Reaves thought he had a very fortunate night against the Detroit Pistons.

games.headline: Dosunmu, Ball lead Timberwolves past slumping Jazz, 115-100
games.desc: — Ayo Dosunmu scored 26 points and LaMelo Ball added 24 points and five assists to help the Minnesota Timberwolves beat the Utah Jazz 115-100 on Sunday night.

games.headline: Cooper Flagg has 25 points, career-best 12 assists as Mavericks beat Nets 130-93
games.desc: — Cooper Flagg had 25 points and a career-high 12 assists for his third consecutive double-double and fourth of the season as the Dallas Mavericks beat the Brooklyn Nets 130-93 on Sunday night.

games.headline: Paul George and Jayson Tatum lead Celtics to a 117-97 victory over the Bucks
games.desc: — Paul George scored 27 points, Jayson Tatum added 21 and the Boston Celtics rolled to a 117-97 victory over the slumping Milwaukee Bucks on Sunday night.

games.headline: Clippers beat Pelicans to end 7-game losing streak
games.desc: — Darius Garland had 24 points and 10 assists, Brook Lopez added 20 points and the Los Angeles Clippers ended a seven-game losing streak with a 139-123 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans on Sunday night.

games.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo scores 29 points to lead the Heat to a 114-108 win over the struggling Kings
games.desc: — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 29 points, 14 rebounds, and three assists in the Miami Heat’s 114-108 win over the Sacramento Kings on Sunday.
